(async()=>{window.__pendingDesign=await window.__runLocalTool('read_architect_design',{expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId});if(!window.__pendingDesign.pendingDraft)throw Error('Expected real unfinished wall gesture');const n=await window.__localTools.find(t=>t.name==='navigate_workspace').execute({expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId,pane:'overview'});if(!n.isError||!n.content[0].text.includes('Finish or cancel'))throw Error('Navigation discarded draft');const d=await window.__localTools.find(t=>t.name==='draw_architect_elements').execute({expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId,expectedRevision:window.__pendingDesign.project.revision,operations:[{kind:'line',levelId:window.__pendingDesign.project.levels[0].id,a:[0,1000],b:[8000,1000]}]});if(!d.isError||!d.content[0].text.includes('drawing gesture'))throw Error('Tool overwrote unfinished gesture');return {navigation:n,draw:d};})()

(async()=>{const p=await window.__runLocalTool('read_architect_design',{expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId});if(p.pendingDraft)throw Error('Escape did not finish gesture');const key='xray:architect:v1:'+encodeURIComponent(window.__toolContext.projectId),before=localStorage.getItem(key),original=Storage.prototype.setItem;Storage.prototype.setItem=function(k,v){if(k!==key)return original.call(this,k,v)};let result;try{result=await window.__localTools.find(t=>t.name==='draw_architect_elements').execute({expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId,expectedRevision:p.project.revision,operations:[{kind:'line',levelId:p.project.levels[0].id,a:[0,1000],b:[8000,1000]}]})}finally{Storage.prototype.setItem=original}if(!result.isError||!result.content[0].text.includes('could not be verified'))throw Error('Silent failed write reported success');if(localStorage.getItem(key)!==before)throw Error('Readback failure changed saved bytes');window.__guardedRevision=p.project.revision;return result;})()

(async()=>{await window.__runLocalTool('navigate_workspace',{expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId,pane:'sketch'});const p=await window.__runLocalTool('read_architect_design',{expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId});if(p.project.revision!==window.__guardedRevision||p.blocked||p.project.lines.length!==2)throw Error('Reopen after readback failure lost saved design');return {revision:p.project.revision,blocked:p.blocked,lines:p.project.lines.length};})()
